slot_scores.name: annual_income_definition
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether the annual income figures are gross or net, nor whether expenses/taxes are already factored in. It silently treated the income values as the objective coefficients.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The given annual income figures can be used directly as net income in the objective, with no need to subtract ongoing expenses or taxes.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether the annual income amounts were gross or net, and the user did not volunteer this information.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved slot is P2 (annual income definition), which is a minor boundary/reporting detail.

summary: The agent clarified the core objective, budget, subset rules, all-or-nothing purchase structure, and the one-way conditional constraint, then stopped appropriately. It missed the low-severity question of whether annual income is gross or net, silently assuming the figures are directly usable.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
